label: Straight Welt 2.5 cm

profile.distinguishingDetail: At 2.5 cm the straight welt breast pocket represents the most widely used English standard, balancing visibility with formality. It sits precisely in the sweet spot between the ultra-narrow and the wider Italian welt, making it the default reference point for most British bespoke houses and many quality ready-to-wear makers. The opening is left completely empty so the full 2.5 cm depth of the welt reads clearly against the chest, its top and bottom edges parallel along the whole length.

The geometry of a straight welt pocket is simple: the visible welt is a folded rectangle.

1. Finished Welt Height
W=2.5 cmW = 2.5\text{ cm}

Where:

WW = finished visible welt height.
2. Cut Welt Width

A welt is folded in half.

Formula
CW=2W+2SACW = 2W + 2SA

Where:

CWCW = cut width
SASA = seam allowance

Using a 1 cm seam allowance:

CW=(2×2.5)+2CW = (2 \times 2.5) + 2 CW=7.0 cmCW = 7.0\text{ cm}
Result
7.0 cm\boxed{7.0\text{ cm}}
